summary.en: Almirall concentrates on medical dermatology, combining biologic lifecycle expansion with a largely proof-of-concept pipeline. Its November update highlights four ongoing Phase 2 studies and two additional planned studies across three investigational molecules.
summary.zh: Almirall 专注于医学皮肤病领域,将生物制剂生命周期拓展与以概念验证为主的管线相结合。其 11 月更新重点介绍了涉及三个在研分子的四项进行中的 II 期研究和两项计划开展的研究。

ind.en: Paediatric atopic dermatitis (EU registration); nummular eczema (Phase 3)
ind.zh: 儿童特应性皮炎(欧盟注册);钱币状湿疹(III期)

ind.en: Hidradenitis suppurativa; planned pyoderma gangrenosum study
ind.zh: 化脓性汗腺炎;计划开展坏疽性脓皮病研究

next.en: Start pyoderma gangrenosum proof-of-concept study toward year-end
next.zh: 年底前启动坏疽性脓皮病概念验证研究

ind.en: Alopecia areata; atopic dermatitis; planned SLE with cutaneous manifestations
ind.zh: 斑秃;特应性皮炎;计划开展伴皮肤表现的SLE研究

next.en: Start proof-of-concept study in SLE with cutaneous manifestations toward year-end
next.zh: 年底前启动伴皮肤表现的SLE概念验证研究

ind.zh: 隐性营养不良型/交界型大疱性表皮松解症

watch.en: The November results update expects first pipeline readouts in Q4 2026; it does not allocate dates to individual assets.
watch.zh: 11 月业绩更新预计首批管线数据将于 2026 年第四季度读出;未给出各个资产的具体时间。

watch.en: European dermatology generated €520.3 million of €889.2 million group net sales in 9M 2026.
watch.zh: 2026 年前九个月,欧洲皮肤科业务贡献了集团 €889.2 million 净销售额中的 €520.3 million。

watch.en: A Q3 2026 CrystalO collaboration adds ion-channel small-molecule discovery in dermatology.
watch.zh: 2026 年第三季度与 CrystalO 的合作新增了皮肤病领域离子通道小分子药物发现。

sources: FY2024 release: readthrough mechanism and licensing (February 2025)

gaps: Company-wide phase counts were not verified; counts is null. The current pipeline URL timed out on repeat opens; its search-indexed asset table and the November 9 results release were reviewed.
The pipeline table labels pyoderma gangrenosum and cutaneous SLE Phase 2, but the November release says these studies are planned toward year-end; their start milestones remain prospective.
Tirbanibulin registration is actinic-keratosis lifecycle management without a verified new indication and remains excluded; multiple indications of each molecule are combined.

Origin of the anti-IL-13/OX40L bispecific remains unverified. Lebrikizumab, anti-IL-1RAP, anti-IL-21, IL-2muFc and readthrough-inducer licenses are explicit in company materials; source releases from 2023/2025 and the February 2026 deck predate 2026-06 and are used for provenance/mechanism only.
The November release forecasts first PoC readouts this quarter without allocating them by molecule; no asset-specific readout date is inferred. Other next milestones remain null.
The supplied checker rejects null phase/origin values although the research brief permits them; unsupported values are retained as null rather than invented to satisfy validation.
